description: Relax and unwind in a downtown Parisian cocoon! So near to the most important sightseeing’s and yet so far from the street hustle and bustle! A French Heritage listed building with a contemporary design, lots of oeuvres d’arts from art galleries in the lobby, a bespoken service specially tailored by our team for all your requests. All the ingredients put together to spend with us a memorable stay and to be pampered as you have never been before. 5* boutique hôtel, fab location, 45rooms&5suitesThe spaceFabulous French ancient apartment, with the stunning ceiling height of 4.5m, flooded with light, impressive chandelier, all the details to feel the French touch of modernity. The suite is composed by a living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 3 WC. The master bathroom has 2 sinks, bathtub and shower, and TOT WC. The living room has a toilet and the other bedroom a bathroom with shower. In the living room, there is a large sofa bed, once opened it is a real comfortable bed for 2 adults.Suitable for families of 6 adults and one baby maximum 2 years old.• Typical Parisian style • Size: 100m²• Street view• Marble bathroom• Double beds in the bedrooms or king beds• Tea & coffee facilities replenished on daily basis complimentary• Carafe of flavored water offered and replenished on daily basis• Bathrobes• Slippers• Shampoo, soap, shower gel, hair conditioner, body lotion, shaving kit, dental kit, hair comb, shower cap, cotton buds, make up cotton wipes, sewing kit, shoehorn, laundry bag replenished on daily basis• Baby upon request for a child max 2-year-old• Welcome amenities: bottle of rosé and macaroons LADUREEGuest access• Access to the screening room upon availability• LIMON, our chic brasserie & cocktail bar• Fabulous Rooftop BAR with stunning Eiffel Tower view (during the su
